_comment: Curated public-domain German texts for the Wortgut library. Text bodies are NOT committed: scripts/import_texts.py downloads each text_url into data/texts/ (gitignored) and stores it in the local database. License: all authors died more than 70 years ago, so the works are public domain in Germany and marked public domain in the USA by Project Gutenberg.
